responsibility: Primary internal interface for the Objective-C front end’s semantic layer. It declares core language hooks from objc-act.cc, defines the tree-layout access macros and flag conventions for Objective-C-specific decl/type/expr nodes such as methods and properties, names the global tree slots and reserved runtime identifiers used across the front end, and exposes small inline helpers and shared data structures like objc_try_context that both parser code and runtime ABI emitters depend on.
same_name_distinction: Declaration and macro interface for the objc-act semantic layer: it exposes the types, tree accessors, flags, global-tree names, and function prototypes that other ObjC front-end and runtime files include. Unlike objc-act.cc, it does not implement parsing or semantic actions itself.
